verdicts.reason: A is evenly spaced, with a clear stack from logo to headline to subhead to CTA to pills, but its CTA floats awkwardly at the right above the pills: its left edge matches Honey Rosemary but its right edge doesn't. That leaves a large empty space at the top right, and the peach circle is cropped to a small stub in the corner. B makes the headline and CTA bigger, but the headline runs nearly to the right edge, so the margins are uneven. Its oversized CTA is also squeezed between the subhead and the pills with very little gap and doesn't line up with the pill row, so it feels cramped and less deliberate than A.
